Author: Akari
Name: Housing Unlocked
Punchline: See every snap before it happens.
Description: Housing placement toolkit for FFXIV. See the snap before you place: floor distance measured from the item's own collision data, item-to-item ranges from each item's SphereCastRange, wall attachment from the receiver's own snap walls (partitions, stage panels, house walls), and tabletop surfaces from TableTop collision. Full position/rotation control on top, inherited from BDTH by LeonBlade. Open with /hu. ⚠ Under active testing — not a fully working product yet; features may be incomplete or behave unexpectedly.
